explication: ThinkRail is an agentic IDE built around the pi coding agent. The primary workflow is to open a project, work in an isolated workspace, chat with an agent that can use project tools, then inspect and review the resulting changes. The README also describes specs, skills, terminals, MCP, notifications, and native/browser delivery as important product capabilities. Several backend connections are documented rather than visible in the sampled source, so those edges cite the README; unsampled implementation details are not inferred.
